I now have enough understanding of the codebase patterns (shop transaction endpoint, character service, game-console actions) to give a complete file list.

## Worker (backend)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/routes/inn.ts` **(new)** | New Hono router mirroring `shop.ts`. Add `POST /api/inn/rest` handler: load character via `getCharacter`, compute cost (e.g. `REST_COST_PER_HP` or flat `REST_COST_GP`), validate `character.gold >= cost` and `character.hp < character.max_hp`, then `updateCharacter(db, characterId, { hp: character.max_hp, gold: character.gold - cost })`, return `{ success, updatedCharacter }`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` | Import `innRoutes` from `./routes/inn.js`; register `app.route('/api/inn', innRoutes);` alongside the existing `shopRoutes` registration. |
| `worker/src/services/character.ts` | No new function strictly required — reuse existing `getCharacter`/`updateCharacter` (already supports `hp` and `gold` in its `Partial<Pick<Character,...>>` type). Optionally add a `restAtInn(db, characterId, cost)` helper here instead of inline route logic, for consistency with other services. |
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add a `RestBody` interface (e.g. `{ sessionId: string; characterId: string; }`) and optionally a `REST_COST_GP` constant, following the pattern of `ShopTransactionBody`. |

## Angular frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId): Observable<{ success: boolean; updatedCharacter: Character }>` calling `POST ${API_BASE}/api/inn/rest`, mirroring `shopTransaction`. |
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | No new model needed if the response just returns `Character`; add a `RestResponse` interface only if you want a typed shape distinct from the shop pattern. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `restLoading` signal and a `restAtInn()` method that calls `api.restAtInn(...)`, updates `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, and pushes a narrative/system log entry (e.g. "You rest at the inn and recover to full HP."); handle insufficient-gold error via snackbar/log message. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn" button (likely near suggested actions or a new toolbar icon) bound to `restAtInn()`, disabled when `charSvc.character().hp === charSvc.character().max_hp` or loading. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts` | No change needed — `setCharacter` already exists and updates the shared signal used by HP/gold displays in `character-sheet.component.ts`. |

**Key values:** `Character.hp`, `Character.max_hp`, `Character.gold` (all in `game.models.ts`); cost constant to define (flat gp or per-HP rate).
